player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**-na re.
Nanhte shawngka **[macro  micro]** (kum shi 0-8) hte hka:
• *macro*  = kade mini-board nanhte shawngka re
• *micro* = kade mini-board kaw shawngka re
Example `[7 8]` ➜ nanhte mark mini-board 7, shawngka 8 hta hka, shi hte
nanhte hpang de shawngka mini-board 8 hta.

Nanhte `{symbol}` re.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Shamu shamawt ai lam gaw, 0-8 ngu nna masat da ai [macro micro] hkrang hte galaw ra ai.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Index ni yawng gaw 0 hte 8 lapran hta nga ra ai.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: micro_board, row or col gaw n lu ai.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Dai gawk hta masha nga sai.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Dai hpang na micro board hta ginsup ra ai.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Dai micro board hpe lu la sai.

next_board.any: micro board ni hpe lang ai shaloi:

game_action.played: Player {player_id} mini board {macro_idx} hta, shawngka {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}) hta shawngka ai. Player {opponent_id} hpang de {nxt_txt} hta shawngka ra ai.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} gaw Ultimate Tic Tac Toe hpe dang ai.
outcome.draw: Dai gaw dang ai hku byin wa sai.
